rows.Origin: Bred by W. Kordes & Sons (Germany, before 1994).
rows.Bloom: White. Moderate fragrance. Double (17-25 petals), cluster-flowered, in small clusters, high-centered to cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Pointed buds.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for cut flower or garden.
